mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 29, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. 'Israeli settlers laid siege to our home': Inside a Palestinian village under weekly attack. A home on the edge of al-Mughayyir has become a weekly frontline in the battle for the occupied West Bank. This was reported by BBC News. 2. A safe space for Gaza women: A sanctuary to speak, heal and share amid war. A women's safe spaces initiative in Gaza offers psychological support and awareness sessions. This was reported by Al Jazeera.
